actions: Implemented a stable-sidecar append/valid-prefix-repair facade with lock-path and data-path inode identity checks.

Ran 400 single-slot multiprocessing campaigns combining process death during torn append, repair, duplicate ADMIT, duplicate RESERVE, exactly-one scorer launch, SLOT/COMMIT versus deadline CLOSE, and restart replay.
Ran 300 two-slot campaigns with duplicate reservation on one slot, a normal second slot, deliberate missing COMMIT recovery, deadline CLOSE race, exact block-score validation and restart replay.
Ran 100 deliberate sidecar lock-path rebind trials and verified operations detected rebinding before reporting success.
Researched current primary documentation for Cloud Storage generation-match preconditions, S3 If-Match conditional writes, and etcd compare-and-swap transactions.
Built a small distributed storage model separating storage-enforced generation CAS, lease-only ownership, and monotonic fencing.

validated_summary.distributed_model: generation/ETag CAS serialized same-object writers; lease-only admitted a stale-writer counterexample; storage-enforced monotonic fencing rejected stale fence

blockers_or_scope: The concurrency campaigns are contract-faithful at the durability/event layer but do not yet byte-execute the entire blob-pinned provenance/reporting sibling graph in one checkout.
Local results assume a cooperative single-host POSIX filesystem with reliable flock.
Distributed CAS/fencing conclusions are a state-model boundary supported by storage/API documentation, not a deployment benchmark or backend selection.
termination_cause: current automation invocation boundary with nonempty continuation frontier; no global completion claimed
exact_next_action: Create a blob-pinned exact-runtime preflight manifest for every provenance sibling file, materialize them in one directory, verify each Git blob SHA before import, inject StableSidecarJournalIO for main/ledger writes, and rerun the two-slot reservation/recovery/deadline campaign through the real runtime functions. Record any exact missing dependency instead of substituting semantics.
